sections.title: Gröbner-Shirshov bases for associative algebras and Lie algebras
sections.extract: Gröbner-Shirshov bases for Lie algebras is established by Shirshov [@{[Sh62]}; @{[Sh09]}] for the free Lie algebras (with deg-lex order) in 1962 (see also Bokut [@b72]). In 1976, Bokut [@{[Bok76]}] specialized the approach of Shirshov to associative algebras (see also Bergman [@b]). For commutative polynomials, this is due to Buchberger [@bu65; @bu70].

sections.title: PBW theorems
sections.extract: There are 8 PBW (Poincare-Birkhoff-Witt) theorems that are proved by using GS bases and Composition-Diamond lemmas.

sections.title: Shirshov's, Cartier's, Cohn's counter examples to PBW for Lie algebras over commutative algebra
sections.extract: Shirshov [@{[Sh53b]}] 1953 and Cartier [@{[Cartier]}] 1958 give counter examples to PBW for Lie algebras over commutative algebra.
